objective: Continuation authorized by the owner on 2026-10-30 ('Yes, let's continue with this.'), taking the recommendation of SPACE-SELECTION-20261030-001: prove or cite that every connected 3-regular triple system other than the Fano plane is 2-colourable, so that the Fano gadgets are the knot's only three-fold spaces, then classify mixed gluings of two-fold phase locks and three-fold phase knots up to six triangles. Scoping before activation (not evidence) refuted the premise: splicing a Fano plane into a point of another gives a 13-point linear 3-regular triple system that is not 2-colourable, and the matching 13-triangle gluings are exact for the knot (lambda(0) = 25). The reframed question, the more interesting reading under the owner's standing rule: is every three-fold space of the knot built from Fano planes by splicing, with the Fano plane as the single generator? Classical bridge: connected non-2-colourable 3-regular triple systems are the minimally non-2-colourable square hypergraphs, i.e. cubic sign-nonsingular 0/1 matrices, i.e. 2-in 2-out digraphs without even directed cycles (Seymour 1974; Robertson-Seymour-Thomas 1999; McCuaig 2000: F7 is the only strongly 2-connected digraph without even dicycles). Questions: (A) the dictionary, a splice calculus for 3-edge tight cuts with sign twists, closure and infinitude of the knot's three-fold spaces, and a reduction of the full classification to one statement about twisted braces; the mixed-gluing question; (B) exhaustive classification for small sizes. Intuitions targeted: space from logic without a drawn space (a gluing made only of the knot's own contacts); the two/three boundary. No time constraints.
status: Complete 2026-10-30: the premise (only the Fano plane) refuted; the knot's three-fold spaces are the 3-regular triple systems that resist 2-colouring (sign-nonsingular, no even dicycle); exhaustive to 13 points: the Fano plane and the Fano splice; beyond, Fano compositions (7 + 6k) and odd cycles of Fano blocks (21, 27, 35, ...); ticket A's reduction corrected by C; gluings of locks and odd three-fold contacts have no locks. Recommendation: Continue with the grammar of three-fold spaces (2/3).
